label: Aruba CX 8360-12C
description: HPE Aruba Networking CX 8360-12C v2 - 12x 40/50/100G QSFP28 cages (1/1/1-1/1/12), no copper ports. 1RU 100G aggregation/leaf with 2.4 Tbps switching capacity.
notes: HPE Aruba Networking CX 8360 v2 family. I/O census from the QuickSpecs Technical Specifications table, row I/O ports and slots (https://www.hpe.com/us/en/collaterals/collateral.a50004274enw.html, version 23, 15 June 2026), cross-read against the family datasheet a50002121enw Product capabilities list (https://www.hpe.com/psnow/downloadDoc/HPE%20Networking%20CX8360%20Switch%20Series-a50002121enw.pdf?id=a50002121enw). AOS-CX numbers the front panel sequentially from 1/1/1, so QSFP+/QSFP28 cages continue the SFP group. All QSFP ports except those on the 48XT4C support optional 4x10G/4x25G breakout cables - a transceiver mode on the cage, not extra front-panel ports, so no extra interfaces are modelled. 50G is supported on the 16Y2C, 32Y4C and 48Y6C (QuickSpecs Key Features) but is not modelled: the catalogue port shapes stop at each cage native speed. This model: "12 ports of 40GbE/100GbE (QSFP+/QSFP28) (optional 4x10G/25G breakout cables supported)"; the datasheet capability bullet widens it to "12 ports of 40GbE/50GbE/100GbE (QSFP+/QSFP28)", which is why the cages carry 40/50/100G. Every front-panel port is a cage, so the old "12x 40/100G" description was the only shape the catalogue had. Switching capacity 2.4 Tbps (12 x 100G full duplex), 2 PSUs, 3 fans. SKUs: JL708C front-to-back, JL709C back-to-front, base switch JL721C. A QuickSpecs footnote marks one transceiver as not supported on the 12C (JL708C/JL709C).
